memory_verse.label: Bible Portion
memory_verse.text: "Now Joseph was the governor of the land, the person who sold grain to all its people. So when Joseph's brothers arrived, they bowed down to him with their faces to the ground" - Gen 42:6 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Here is a moment more than twenty years in the making. Joseph's brothers, who once mocked his dreams and plotted to destroy them, now stand before the governor of Egypt and bow "with their faces to the ground" — not knowing that this powerful ruler is the very brother they sold into slavery. Long ago, Joseph had dreamed that their sheaves and even the sun, moon, and stars would bow to him (Gen 37:7-9), and they had hated him for it. Now, all unaware, they fulfill his dreams to the letter.

What a stunning display of God's sovereignty. The brothers had tried to kill Joseph precisely to stop his dreams from coming true — "we'll see what comes of his dreams" (Gen 37:20). Yet their very act of selling him into Egypt became the road by which those dreams were fulfilled. They could not thwart God's purposes; they unwittingly served them.

This is one of the great comforts of Scripture: what God has purposed, He will accomplish, and no human opposition can finally stop it. People may resist, delay, or even try to destroy what God intends — but His word will stand. "Many are the plans in a person's heart, but it is the LORD's purpose that prevails" (Prov 19:21).

Whatever God has promised — in His Word, or in the deep sense of calling He has placed in your heart — take courage. His purposes cannot be defeated. In His time, and often in ways we could never predict, He brings them to pass.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
Do you trust that God's purposes cannot be finally defeated?
Where do you need to believe God will fulfill what He has promised?
How does God's sovereignty over this moment encourage you?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You that Your purposes always stand, and no opposition can finally defeat them. Help me to trust that You will fulfill Your word in Your time and in Your way. Amen.
